Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFIGATION FOR 
EXTRACTOR FOR HIP PROSTHESIS 



( Reaffirmed 1997) 



1. Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for extractor used for hip prosthesis in 
orthopaedic surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 



0(A20-i

r-OIA12-5 




All dimensions in minimetres, 
FIG. 1 EXTRACTOR FOR HIP PROSTHESIS 

2.1 A deviation of ±2*5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of 18:6603-1972 'Specification for 
stainless steel bars and flats*. 

4. HeatTreatment — The extractor shall be hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 400 to 
450 H/. 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The stril^er shall be loosely held in the shaft of the extractor. 

5.2 The extractor shall be free from pits, burrs, cracks and other surface defects. 

5.3 It shall be polished bright and passivated. 

6. Performance Test 

6.1 One end of the extractor shall be gripped in a suitable vice and the hook end shall be pulled by 
applying a load of 50 kg. The extractor shall not be damaged after completion of the test. 

6.2 Cofros/on/?es/sfance— The instrument shall satisfy the boiling and autoclaving test as 
mentioned in 15:7531-1975 'Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of 
stainless steel surgical instruments '. 

7- Marking — Shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, Initials or recognized trade-mark. 

7.1 ISl Certification MarA/ng — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
